Looking for new construction luxury homes near Lake Belton? Rancho Del Lago in Morgan’s Point Resort TX might be exactly what you’ve been waiting for! This luxury neighborhood features oversized half-acre lots, preserved mature oak trees, and modern custom home designs—perfect for buyers looking for privacy, space, and Central Texas convenience!

In this video, I take you inside brand-new homes in Rancho Del Lago, showing the latest floor plans, high-end finishes, and all the details that make this community so special. You’ll see why families moving to Belton TX, Temple TX, and surrounding areas love this area—including top-performing Belton ISD schools, quick access to Lake Belton, parks, dining, and medical facilities.

🏡 Inside this tour:
• Full neighborhood drive-through of Rancho Del Lago
• Two brand-new luxury spec homes (Hoover & Castell floor plans)
• Home prices, lot sizes, and what’s included
• Belton ISD schools, tax rate, and location breakdown
• Lake Belton lifestyle, parks, dining, and medical access

If you’re considering buying a new home near Lake Belton, relocating to Morgan’s Point Resort, or investing in Central Texas luxury real estate, this video is a must-watch!
